## Goal
- Complete end-to-end audit, repair, QA, reconciliation, deployment, and production certification for `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use only canonical repository `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.
- Diagnose GitHub `401` before changing authentication; use minimum permissions and approved owner/GitHub App authentication only.
- Never expose credentials, OTPs, passwords, bearer tokens, service-role keys, or personal identities in logs, commits, terminal output, or chat.
- Preserve all local code; do not reset, overwrite, delete, or remove approved features without explicit authorization.
- Create a recovery branch and backup tag before canonical-history reconciliation.
- Do not deploy until OTP plaintext persistence is eliminated and OTP-focused tests pass.
- Do not certify production without independently verifiable, SHA-matched GitHub, Actions, Render, and live evidence.
- Final acceptance requires `GitHub HEAD = Actions source SHA = Render deployed SHA = live /version SHA`.
- If acceptance remains unproven, final output must start `PRODUCTION NOT YET VERIFIED` and contain only missing proof, exact blocker, required owner action, and next executable step.

## Progress
### Done
- Live endpoints were rechecked:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/health → 200
  https://api.ivxholding.com/version → 200
  ```
- Live `/health` and `/version` currently report:
  ```text
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  commitShort=012bb088
  ```
- GitHub credential diagnosis was repeated safely:
  ```text
  GET https://api.github.com/user → HTTP/2 401
  ```
  - `gh` CLI is unavailable:
    ```text
    sh: 1: gh: not found
    ```
  - Both `GITHUB_TOKEN` and `RORK_PUBLIC_GITHUB_TOKEN` previously returned `401` for GitHub `/user` and canonical repository access.
- Current top-level Git state was inspected:
  ```text
  branch=main
  HEAD=671317c28cb222f8be612312da35fe083b4bc9d2
  ```

  ```text

  19a73a08 Finalized the member registration process and verified the platform is running correctly.

  2b262204 Update app download links and simplify user registration process
  9bc27756 New version from Rork
  63d6cf66 New version from Rork
  ```

  - `recovery/canonical-main` has no `.gitmodules` mapping.

  ```text
  branch=main
  HEAD=4a8481e447dd944450e1a6ca1ad4c5599668cd93
  origin=https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```

  ```ini
  [submodule "ivx-holdings-platform"]
  path = ivx-holdings-platform
  url = https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform.git
  ```

  ```text
  DEPLOYMENT_MARKER = 'ivx-member-verification-v3-hashed-codes'
  CODE_TTL_MINUTES = 10
  CODE_LENGTH = 6
  MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5
  MAX_RESENDS = 3

  ```
  - Uses `randomInt`, `scryptSync`, and `timingSafeEqual`.
  - `VerificationCodeRecord.code` is documented as a salted scrypt hash, not plaintext.
  - Supabase writes `hashCode(code)`.
- Registration handler audit confirmed local validation uses:
  - `confirmPassword` mismatch rejection.
  - Optional `gender`.
  - Registration orchestration through `orchestrateRegistration`.
- Public-chat audit confirmed fallback behavior:
  - `backend/public-chat-ai.ts` declares:
    ```ts
    export type PublicChatSource = 'chatgpt' | 'fallback';
    ```
  - Primary AI is considered configured only when gateway URL and API key are available:
    ```ts
    isIVXAIConfigured(): getIVXAIGatewayRootUrl().length > 0 && getIVXAIGatewayApiKey().length > 0
    ```
  - Failures log and return fallback:
    ```text
    [PublicChatAI] IVX AI request failed, falling back:
    ```
- Installed root dependencies successfully:
  ```text
  bun install --frozen-lockfile
  261 packages installed
  ```
  - This addressed the earlier missing root `ai` dependency resolution error.
- Targeted registration tests previously passed independently:
  ```text
  backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts → 12 pass, 0 fail
  ```
- Prior public-chat smoke evidence remains:
  ```text
  POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/public/chat → 200
  answer="The answer is 4."
  persistence=supabase
  source="fallback"
  ```

### In Progress
- Audit `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts` for secure fallback durability, cleanup, resend cooldown, rate limits, error handling, and schema compatibility.
- Audit `backend/api/ivx-members.ts` verification endpoints for authenticated-user binding and prevention of arbitrary `userId` OTP actions.
- Run targeted tests after dependency restoration:
  ```text
  bun test backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts && bunx tsc --noEmit
  ```
  - Latest command output was truncated before a final result was captured.
- Audit primary AI runtime configuration, provider selection, retry/timeout behavior, persistence, and safe provider telemetry.
- Inventory and review all local commits and uncommitted changes before recovery branch/tag creation and reconciliation.

### Blocked
- Canonical GitHub authentication remains unavailable:
  ```text
  GET https://api.github.com/user → HTTP/2 401
  ```
- GitHub account identity (`ibb142`), token validity/revocation, scopes, GitHub App installation access, SSO state, branch protection, Actions permissions, PRs, workflow runs, and job results cannot be verified.
- Current `origin` is the Rork router rather than direct canonical GitHub:
  ```text
  https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```
- Render credential/service API evidence is unavailable:
  ```text
  GET https://api.render.com/v1/services/srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0 → 400
  ```
- Canonical CI, PR/review/merge state, deployment records, and independent GitHub-to-Render SHA parity cannot be retrieved.
- No approved authenticated member or owner production session is available for real registration completion, OTP verification, sign-in/reset/session tests, owner-module checks, or Supabase record inspection.
- The live SHA `012bb088...` is not proven to include current local OTP and registration repairs.
- Mobile/web E2E, Android emulator, iOS approved-environment tests, release builds, and SHA-matched installation evidence have not been executed.
- The OTP workflow comments explicitly admit production schema/service-role issues:
  ```text
  schema repair requires the service-role key, which is not configured
  ```
- `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts` and `backend/services/ivx-member-database.ts` permit anon-key fallback when the service-role key is absent; production RLS and secure server-side behavior remain unverified.

## Key Decisions
- Do not mark production VERIFIED until all 12 requested acceptance conditions have independent evidence on one exact SHA.
- Treat live `/health` and `/version` as proof only that `012bb088...` is deployed, not as GitHub/Render provenance.
- Preserve top-level and nested checkout state; do not reconcile, reset, or alter gitlinks until canonical authentication is repaired and recovery artifacts are created.
- Do not deploy OTP code until focused tests prove hash-only storage, expiration, single use, bounded attempts/resends, cooldown/rate limits, cleanup, redaction, and safe non-enumerating errors.
- Do not certify public chat while it reports `source:"fallback"`.
- Do not create a real production test member without approved secure session handling and a safe verification/cleanup method.
- Treat anonymous owner-route rejection as limited evidence only; it does not prove authenticated member denial across all owner routes.

## Next Steps
- 1. Complete local OTP and registration endpoint audit, including authenticated `userId` binding for `/api/members/send-email-code`, `/verify-email`, `/send-phone-code`, and `/verify-phone`.
- 2. Add focused OTP security tests for Supabase and durable fallback persistence, plaintext absence, TTL, single use, retry/resend limits, cleanup, safe errors, and log redaction.
- 3. Rerun and capture final results for:
  ```text
  bun test backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts
  bunx tsc --noEmit
  ```
- 4. Run root/backend and Expo lint/type/test checks; record every failure with file, cause, repair, and rerun result.
- 5. Repair canonical GitHub authentication through the approved secure owner/App flow; verify account `ibb142`, canonical repository metadata, default branch, HEAD, commits, PRs, Actions runs, and jobs.
- 6. Create recovery branch and backup tag; then fetch and safely reconcile canonical `main` with approved local commits and changes.
- 7. Commit, push approved branch, open/update PR, obtain required review, merge, and record final canonical SHA.
- 8. Trigger and verify complete CI on the merged SHA only.
- 9. Bind/verify Render production service, deploy the exact merged SHA, restart it, and prove `/health` and `/version` parity.
- 10. With authorized secure sessions, execute controlled production member registration, email/phone verification, duplicate checks, sign-in/reset/session tests, member owner-route denial, and owner-module tests.
- 11. Repair and verify a real primary-model public-chat response with safe provider telemetry and Supabase persistence.
- 12. Build and test web, Android, and iOS from the final SHA; capture version, build ID, timestamp, API URL, launch, member/owner sign-in, and registration evidence.

## Critical Context
- Canonical repository target:
  ```text
  https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
  ```
- Live production currently identifies:
  ```text
  service=ivx-owner-ai-backend
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Top-level local `main`:
  ```text
  HEAD=671317c28cb222f8be612312da35fe083b4bc9d2
  ahead of origin/main by 6 commits
  ```
- Nested `ivx-holdings-platform` checkout:
  ```text
  HEAD=4a8481e447dd944450e1a6ca1ad4c5599668cd93
  ```
- Top-level working tree includes Rork history modifications; nested checkout also reports parent `.rork/history/...` modifications.
- No stash or alternate worktree was reported:
  ```text
  worktree /home/user/rork-app
  branch refs/heads/main
  ```
- Top-level Git traversal emits:
  ```text
  fatal: no submodule mapping found in .gitmodules for path 'recovery/canonical-main'
  ```
- `backend/api/ivx-members.ts` currently selects `userId` from body before authorization fallback:
  ```ts
  const userId = asString(body.userId) || getAuthUserId(request) || '';
  ```
  - This requires security review before deployment because unauthenticated callers may supply arbitrary user IDs.
- OTP service currently has a filesystem/durable-store fallback for schema-missing conditions; filesystem fallback is unsuitable as a production-certification substitute without durability, access-control, and cleanup evidence.
- Root package dependency restoration succeeded; `functions.install` could not be used because no Rork app is registered at root:
  ```text
  No app is registered at path "."
  ```
- Expo package version currently observed:
  ```text
  expo/package.json version=1.4.8
  ```
  - Earlier release-consistency evidence referenced version `1.9.4`; final platform metadata must be regenerated from the final merged SHA.
- Required final evidence remains: canonical repo URL, repaired GitHub access, production branch/SHA, reconciliation summary, changed files, PR, CI URL/results/timestamps, test totals, Render IDs/SHA, health/version parity, Supabase project reference, sanitized registration/auth evidence, primary provider evidence, and web/Android/iOS build evidence.

## Relevant Files
- `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts`: OTP generation, hash persistence, Supabase/durable fallback behavior, expiry, attempts, resend count, and cleanup requirements.
- `backend/api/ivx-members.ts`: registration, verification, login, reset, and potential arbitrary-`userId` verification endpoint issue.
- `backend/services/ivx-member-database.ts`: member/auth persistence and service-role versus anon-key fallback behavior.
- `backend/services/ivx-registration-orchestrator.ts`: idempotent member registration workflow and error contracts.
- `backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts`: targeted registration contract coverage.
- `backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts`: deployment/rollback regression coverage; initially failed due to unresolved `ai` package before `bun install`.
- `backend/public-chat-ai.ts`: public-chat source reporting, fallback behavior, primary response generation, and persistence path.
- `backend/ivx-ai-runtime.ts`: primary AI gateway configuration, model resolution, request deduplication, timeout/cancellation behavior.
- `backend/api/owner-only.ts`: server-side owner authorization guard.
- `backend/hono.ts`: route registration and member endpoint rate limits.
- `backend/supabase/migrations/enterprise_indexes.sql`: existing `verification_codes` index only; no discovered create-table migration.
- `backend/tests/ivx-provider-state-machine.test.ts`: provider fallback state-machine coverage.
- `backend/tests/owner-ai-status-guard.test.ts`: owner-AI status guard coverage.
- `package.json`: root dependencies, including `ai`.
- `expo/package.json`: Expo scripts and currently observed app version.
- `.gitmodules`: only configured `ivx-holdings-platform` submodule mapping.

Yes. I’m responsible for driving the remaining work to a real finish—not jumping between claims. I’ll proceed in order: secure the OTP/member flow, validate it, then only move to the canonical deployment and production proof gates.
